findings.title: Service runs privileged
findings.description: privileged: true disables all container isolation: the service gets every capability and full device access, so a compromise is a host compromise. Grant only the capabilities the service needs via cap_add.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: Service runs as root
findings.description: Without a user: directive the service runs as root; a container breakout then yields host root. Run as a non-root UID/GID.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA on the account and restrict root usage. Create individual IAM users or federate via SSO, attach least-privilege policies, and never use root for daily operations.
